title: Injo Gogi Bap
description: Injo Gogi Bap is a North Korea dish made with textured soy protein, light soy sauce, garlic, yellow onion. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used. Home adaptation using hydrated textured soy protein; traditionally prepared injo gogi has a different texture and shape.

steps.instruction: Hydrate dry textured soy protein in clean hot drinking water until supple, drain and squeeze thoroughly before seasoning.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 14 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Spread the rice evenly into the flavorful liquid. Cook uncovered or partly covered for about 24 minutes until the liquid is absorbed; do not over-stir.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
